data.one_liner: A fakeable wrapper for dart:core clock APIs.
data.what_it_does: Encapsulates the notion of the current time using a Clock class. Allows swapping out the default top-level clock to reliably test timing-dependent code.
use_when: You need to test timing-dependent code reliably
You want to mock time or use fake_async for tests
avoid_when: You only need standard DateTime functionality without mocking or testing requirements
strengths: Integrates seamlessly with the fake_async package
Provides a top-level clock field for default usage
weaknesses: Requires using the wrapper instead of direct dart:core DateTime calls
